fields.Name: Person Lifecycle Changed
fields.Description: The downstream reaction to a person's lifecycle status changing (Active / Inactive / Deceased). Dispatched durably by the People·AfterUpdate Entity Action binding through Execute Agent, with the person's data arriving as the Data payload (bound as 'Entity Object Data'). A deterministic Flow agent on purpose: it records the transition on the person's timeline via Common.LogActivity and finishes — it creates work and completes, it never holds a run open waiting for anyone. Hosts extend the reaction by adding steps here (notify, enrich, hand off) instead of touching the binding.

fields.Name: Log lifecycle change on the timeline
fields.Description: Records the status transition as a SystemEvent activity linked Regarding the person, through the one shared ActivityWriter. The Description carries the new status value; idempotency is deliberately NOT keyed (no EventKey) because a person can change status more than once and each transition belongs on the timeline.
